item.title: Typing Latin Macrons and Breves
item.description: Typing macrons and breves on a Windows machine As part of my transcription of North & Hillard’s Latin Prose Composition, I have needed to type macrons and breves over all five vowels (and their capitals) to accurately transcribe the text.
